description: Traces of the cmux.wire/1 ownership client (backend/packages/ownership/src/client.ts, ProjectionClient) that every client implementation must reproduce: for each input, the frames sent (`op` frames and `snapshot.request {pending}`; `{error: owner_unreachable}` when an op is refused offline) and the client after it. Clients apply event effects and snapshots, detect gaps, hold early settles, resend pending intents on reconnect, expire intents after intent_ttl_ms. `rows` is {table: {key: {key, n, row}}}. Generated by backend/packages/ownership/scripts/export-mirror-vectors.ts.

cases.name: in_order
cases.note: An event at seq+1 applies its effects; the settle after it removes the intent and records it as settled.

cases.name: settle_before_event
cases.note: An ok settle that arrives before the mirror reaches its sequence is held, then applied with the event (no flicker).

cases.name: reject_settles_at_once
cases.note: A failed settle removes the intent at once, with no sequence wait and no settled record.

cases.name: gap_then_snapshot
cases.note: A gap buffers the event and asks for a snapshot with the pending keys; events during the wait buffer; the snapshot settles decided keys and replays the buffer.

cases.name: duplicate_and_old_events
cases.note: Events at or below the confirmed seq are ignored.

cases.name: offline_refuses_new_ops
cases.note: Disconnected: a new op is refused (U5), frames are ignored; reconnect resends the pending intent with its key and asks for a snapshot.

cases.name: lost_reply_settled_by_snapshot
cases.note: A reply lost across a reconnect is settled by the snapshot's decided list; a failed decision leaves no settled record.

cases.name: older_snapshot_keeps_state
cases.note: A snapshot older than the confirmed seq does not replace state or settle keys, but the buffered events still replay.

cases.name: snapshot_replaces_rows
cases.note: A snapshot with rows replaces the rows held before; one without rows keeps them.

cases.name: event_without_effects_desyncs
cases.note: A mirror without a reducer for the op counts a desync and asks for a snapshot instead of guessing.

cases.name: retry_resends_same_key
cases.note: A timeout retry resends the same frame with the same key; an unknown key sends nothing.

cases.name: intent_ttl
cases.note: An intent older than the TTL moves to expired and is never resent; the snapshot request still asks about it, and a decided answer clears it.
